entities.name: PMID:10728379
observations: Huber SA. T cells expressing the gamma delta T cell receptor induce apoptosis in cardiac myocytes. Cardiovascular Research, 2000.
In a murine CVB3 myocarditis model, isolated cardiac γδ T cells killed cultured myocytes; blocking experiments indicated predominantly Fas-mediated killing, more effective than αβ T cells in vitro.

entities.name: Gamma delta T cells kill myocytes
observations: Isolated cardiac γδ T cells induced cardiac-myocyte death in vitro, predominantly Fas-mediated; the study found greater apoptosis-inducing activity than αβ T cells in a murine CVB3 myocarditis context.
